title: GroundX’s Crucial Departure: A Pivotal Shift for Kaia Governance Council
body: BitcoinWorld GroundX’s Crucial Departure: A Pivotal Shift for Kaia Governance Council The dynamic world of cryptocurrency and blockchain is always abuzz with significant developments, and a recent announcement from the Kaia governance forum has certainly captured the attention of industry watchers. On June 30, GroundX, the esteemed blockchain subsidiary of South Korean tech giant Kakao, officially stepped down from the Kaia Governance Council . This move marks a pivotal moment for the Kaia ecosystem and sends ripples across the broader South Korean blockchain landscape. What does this departure signify for the future of Kaia, and what implications does it hold for Kakao’s blockchain ambitions? Understanding the Kaia Governance Council and GroundX’s Role To fully grasp the magnitude of this news, it is essential to understand the structure and purpose of the Kaia Governance Council . As a decentralized project, Kaia relies on a council of influential entities to guide its strategic direction, validate transactions, and ensure the stability and growth of its network. Members of such councils are typically key players in the blockchain space, bringing expertise, resources, and credibility to the ecosystem. GroundX, as the blockchain arm of Kakao, a company that dominates South Korea’s messaging app market with KakaoTalk, was a founding and prominent member of this council. Their involvement lent significant weight and legitimacy to Kaia, given Kakao’s massive user base and technological prowess. GroundX’s role extended beyond mere validation; they were instrumental in shaping the early policies, technical specifications, and community initiatives for what was then the Klaytn network, which recently merged to form Kaia. The council’s responsibilities include: Network Operations: Running validator nodes to secure the network. Strategic Direction: Voting on proposals for protocol upgrades and ecosystem development. Ecosystem Growth: Contributing to the expansion of dApps and user adoption. Community Engagement: Acting as a bridge between the core development team and the wider community. GroundX’s departure creates a vacancy that will undoubtedly be watched closely by the community, eager to see who will step in to fill such an influential position. Who is GroundX and What is Their Legacy? GroundX is not just any blockchain company; it is the dedicated blockchain subsidiary of Kakao, South Korea’s leading mobile platform. Launched with ambitious goals, GroundX was the force behind Klaytn, a prominent blockchain network that aimed to bring blockchain technology to the mainstream through user-friendly applications and services. Klaytn gained significant traction, particularly in South Korea, becoming a cornerstone for various decentralized applications, NFTs, and GameFi projects. GroundX’s legacy includes: Klaytn Network: Developing and maintaining the Klaytn blockchain, which now forms the backbone of Kaia after its merger with Finschia. Klip Wallet: Integrating a cryptocurrency wallet directly into KakaoTalk, making digital asset management accessible to millions of users. Developer Support: Fostering a vibrant developer ecosystem through grants, hackathons, and technical documentation. Enterprise Adoption: Collaborating with numerous traditional businesses to explore blockchain use cases. Their deep integration with Kakao’s ecosystem provided Klaytn (and by extension, Kaia) with a unique advantage in terms of user reach and brand recognition. The decision for GroundX to step down is therefore more than just a procedural change; it signals a significant shift in the strategic alignment of a major player in the blockchain space. What Does This Mean for Kakao’s Blockchain Strategy? The resignation of GroundX from the Kaia Governance Council naturally prompts questions about the broader Kakao blockchain strategy. For years, Kakao has been a pioneer in integrating blockchain technology into its vast array of services. From the Klip wallet embedded in KakaoTalk to its ventures into NFTs and Web3 gaming, Kakao has consistently shown a commitment to leveraging decentralized technologies. There are several potential interpretations of this move: Strategic Re-evaluation: Kakao might be re-evaluating its core blockchain focus, perhaps shifting resources towards new, more centralized, or different blockchain initiatives. The highly competitive and rapidly evolving blockchain landscape often necessitates such strategic pivots. Focus on Core Business: It could indicate a decision to concentrate more on Kakao’s core messaging and platform businesses, with blockchain efforts becoming more integrated rather than distinct subsidiary-led projects. Decentralization Push: Paradoxically, it could also be a move to further decentralize the Kaia network, allowing it to operate more independently of its founding corporate entities. This would align with the broader ethos of decentralization in the blockchain world. Regulatory Considerations: The evolving regulatory environment in South Korea and globally might be influencing Kakao’s approach to its blockchain ventures, leading to a more cautious or restructured involvement. Whatever the underlying reasons, this decision will undoubtedly reshape the trajectory of the Kakao blockchain presence and its influence within the global Web3 arena. The Significance of Kaia as an EVM-compatible Layer-1 Blockchain Kaia is not just any blockchain; it is an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain . This technical detail is crucial to understanding its potential and the impact of GroundX’s departure. EVM compatibility means that Kaia can seamlessly run smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps) originally designed for Ethereum. This interoperability is a massive advantage, allowing developers to easily migrate or deploy their Ethereum-based projects onto Kaia, benefiting from its potentially lower transaction fees and higher throughput. Key characteristics of an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain like Kaia: Scalability: Designed to handle a larger volume of transactions than Ethereum’s mainnet, often through different consensus mechanisms. Lower Costs: Typically offers significantly lower gas fees, making dApps more accessible for everyday users. Developer Familiarity: Leverages the widely adopted Solidity programming language and Ethereum’s development tools, attracting a broad pool of talent. Security: As a layer-1, it aims to provide its own robust security infrastructure, rather than relying on a separate base layer. The departure of a key council member like GroundX could test the resilience and decentralization of Kaia’s governance model, but its fundamental technical strengths as an EVM-compatible layer-1 remain intact. The network’s ability to attract and retain developers will be key to its continued success. Broader Implications for the South Korean Blockchain Landscape South Korea has long been a hotbed for blockchain innovation, with a tech-savvy population and a government increasingly exploring the potential of digital assets. The news of GroundX’s exit from the Kaia Governance Council will certainly resonate across the entire South Korean blockchain ecosystem. South Korea’s blockchain scene is characterized by: Corporate Involvement: Major conglomerates like Samsung, LG, and Kakao have invested heavily in blockchain technology. Gaming and Entertainment: A strong focus on GameFi and NFTs, leveraging the country’s dominant gaming industry. Regulatory Evolution: A dynamic regulatory environment that seeks to balance innovation with investor protection. Global Ambitions: Many South Korean projects aim for global expansion, not just domestic dominance. The departure of GroundX might signal a shift in how large corporations engage with decentralized governance structures. It could lead to other corporate players re-evaluating their commitments or inspire new, more independent entities to step up. The long-term impact on South Korea’s standing as a blockchain innovation hub will depend on how the industry adapts to such changes and whether new leaders emerge to fill the void. What’s Next for Kaia and the Future Outlook? Despite the significant news, Kaia, as an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain , is built for resilience. The network will continue to operate, and the remaining members of the Kaia Governance Council will work to ensure stability and progress. The focus will likely shift towards attracting new, diverse council members who can contribute to Kaia’s next phase of growth. For the Kaia community and stakeholders, key areas to watch include: New Council Members: Who will join the council, and what expertise will they bring? Ecosystem Development: Will the pace of dApp development and user acquisition continue, or even accelerate? Strategic Partnerships: Kaia may seek new partnerships to strengthen its position in the market. Technological Roadmaps: Continued focus on enhancing scalability, security, and developer experience. The departure of GroundX is a moment of transition, but it also presents an opportunity for Kaia to demonstrate its maturity and truly decentralized nature. The project’s ability to navigate this change will be a testament to its long-term viability and its potential to remain a key player in the global blockchain arena. In conclusion, GroundX’s decision to step down from the Kaia Governance Council marks a significant event in the South Korean blockchain space. While the full implications for both Kakao blockchain strategies and Kaia’s future remain to be seen, this development underscores the dynamic and ever-evolving nature of the blockchain industry. As an EVM-compatible layer-1 blockchain , Kaia is positioned for continued growth, and its journey forward without GroundX will be a crucial test of its decentralized governance model. The community will be keenly watching how this pivotal shift shapes the next chapter for Kaia and its role in the broader Web3 ecosystem. To learn more about the latest crypto market trends, explore our article on key developments shaping the South Korean blockchain landscape. title: Expert Explains Why XRP Price Remains Stagnant, Predicts Timeline for Next Rally
body: A notable community figure provides insight into why the price of XRP has remained stagnant, outlining when it might begin to appreciate again. XRP’s price has been stagnant despite positive developments in the Ripple lawsuit over the past few months. Notably, the price has been hovering around the $2 region for the last five months.While many expected the Ripple and SEC resolution , which began in March, to result in a strong rally, XRP only registered slight gains. Legal Resolution-Driven Rally Already Priced InCommenting, Vincent Van Code, a software engineer and XRP community figure, noted that Judge Analisa Torres resolved a significant part of the Ripple case in her summary judgment decision issued in July 2023. He added that the ruling established XRP’s legal status as a non-security when traded in secondary markets. In his view, the legal resolution–driven rally had already occurred earlier this year. Many anticipated a resolution in the lawsuit between the SEC and Ripple even before the re-election of Donald Trump, prompting them to position their portfolios early. Following Trump’s re-election, it became evident that a resolution was around the corner. As a result, investors scooped up vast amounts of XRP toward the end of 2024 and early 2025, with XRP soaring to $3.4 in January. Since then, XRP has plunged to around $2 and has continued to hover within the region. Catalyst for the Next Rally Despite XRP’s stagnation, Vincent predicted that the token could witness a significant rally in the coming months. According to him, this price surge will commence when institutions announce new partnerships with Ripple and leverage ODL for cross-border settlements. He noted that while some institutions have already unveiled these integrations, others are quietly working on them for potential rollouts. Vincent also argued that XRP’s primary obstacle isn’t legal uncertainty but rather the lack of a robust demand infrastructure. “The rails aren’t fully live yet,” Vincent remarked. He suggested that regulated entities can take up to 24 months from initial approval to complete an enterprise deployment. Referencing the timeline of the Ripple summary judgment decision (July 2023) as the starting point, Vincent claimed most institutions began integrating with Ripple's payment solution toward the end of last year. “That puts us in the final stretch of the rollout timeline now,” he added. Once these financial institutions complete their integrations, Vincent expects XRP to experience strong demand, driving its price upward. He predicted that the next XRP rally would occur within the next 2-3 months, specifically between August and September 2025. However, he did not set a price target for XRP or indicate how high the coin might soar in the coming months. In the meantime, XRP is trading at $2.18, representing a 7.98% increase over the past week.

AI meets blockchain – Launch of Pi App Studio At the core of the releases is Pi App Studio, a no-code, AI-assisted platform which enables anyone – regardless of technical background – to build and own functional apps in Pi’s decentralized ecosystem. The significance of this AI initiative is threefold. Contributing to the AI application layer of the world, Pi innovates through guided app-creation workflows atop the world’s current AI infrastructure breakthroughs while leveraging the crowd creativity of the Pi community and the distribution channels of Pi’s social network. Experimenting to explore an economic model which provides for the sustainable coexistence of human intelligence and AI using blockchain – an essential global problem to solve in the future age of AI. Scaling the grassroots capability of ordinary pioneers to use their innovation and respective expertise to create apps and develop ecosystem utility using AI and the blockchain. Pi App Studio provides guided AI-powered workflows to facilitate and assist ordinary people to create, customize and run apps using their existing domain knowledge and experience. This allows for more iterations and attempts at app creation by a wider-range of people in a decentralized way – at cheaper engineering costs than the time it took to create such applications in the Web 2.0 era. The current version of the Pi App Studio allows users to either follow one workflow to create topic-specific AI chatbot apps trained on their personal domain knowledge and expertise or create any type of app without the need to code. More workflows created on top of the current platform can guide the creation of more app types. This marks a strategic step toward Pi Network’s broader vision – solving the world’s important production and social problems through Pi Network, while scaling app production and ownership through AI and blockchain infrastructure. Chengdiao Fan, head of product and one of two Pi founders, said, “The ultimate utility of any technology, including blockchain, resides in solving the fundamental problems of humankind. Today we’re at a pivotal moment with respect to AI infrastructure breakthroughs. “We continue to see a lack of development with regard to the AI application layer between AI infrastructure and real production – in addition to the lack of clarity regarding the role of human labor, and intelligence in the future and lingering questions about human wellbeing in the age of AI. “Pi, based in blockchain technology and with its large global verified human community, strives to provide innovations and solutions for these problems – in conjunction with the innovative use of and decentralized access to AI to facilitate app creation to further utility for both the Pi community and the world. “Pi, in turn, can continue to expand functionality, app creation, utility and productivity within its ecosystem. “If Pi wants to have more apps in its ecosystem, let’s scale creation using the most current technology – AI – [to] enable more people, not just engineers, to be creators, and generate apps of the next generation, not apps of the past era. “That was how Pi App Studio was born.” Ecosystem directory staking – Decentralized app support Pi Network introduced another platform-level utility – ‘e cosystem directory staking,’ a mechanism allowing businesses and users to boost the ranking of Pi apps in the ecosystem interface by staking Pi tokens on the mainnet blockchain. Apps with more stakes receive increased global visibility through higher ranking in the Pi ecosystem, creating an incentive loop that rewards quality and community engagement. The mechanism was designed to balance users’ needs for getting relevant and interesting apps. The staking is meant for Pi app developers to decide whether and in which format they want to incentivize their users to stake Pi for their app as the individual Pi apps are the beneficiaries of the ranking and visibility – t here are no rewards on the protocol level. Future iterations of this feature will help calibrate and adjust the specific staking mechanism. This platform-level utility not only relies on the Pi community’s collective resource – attention – but also distinguishes itself from Web 2.0 app ranking systems largely controlled by rigid algorithms or advertising corporations. With ecosystem interface staking, Pi is supporting an app directory of the Web 3.0 world. Additional ecosystem enhancements Pi’s Pi2Day 2025 update also includes the following. Onramper integration – Pi wallet now integrates Onramper third-party, KYB-verified on-ramp aggregator that simplifies on-ramp services for pioneers. Mainnet migration – Updates enable more pioneers to become eligible for migration – in addition to the normal migration flow – unblocking over 500,000 pioneers who were previously unable to proceed Node updates – Node version 0.5.2 renames the Node app to ‘Node Desktop’ to be more general, accurate and open to integrations on desktop computers that are not necessarily related to Node (e.g. Pi App Studio). It now includes the Pi Node and mining app. This version includes other updates such as improved security. Pi released a Node ranking page on Pi Blockexplorer, which displays the top 5,000 Pi nodes based on key performance metrics. The .pi domains auction extension – Due to the release of Pi App Studio where many pioneers can create and run their own apps, thus needing domains for their apps, the .pi domains auction’s deadline is extended to September 30, 2025. This provides pioneers more time to innovate and build functional apps, and to bid for .pi domains for their apps. Ecosystem challenge – An interactive in-app challenge offers fun rewards to users who explore Pi’s tools and complete ecosystem tasks. It will run until July 7, 2025. These efforts underscore Pi Network’s scalable, utility-focused and human-centered ecosystem in a world increasingly shaped by AI. About Pi Network Pi Network is a community of tens of millions of humans mining Pi cryptocurrency to use and build the Web 3.0 app ecosystem. Founded in 2018 by a team of early innovators in blockchain and social computing, with PhDs from Stanford University, Pi Network is a utilities-based ecosystem for third-party apps on a mobile web platform, with widespread (rather than concentrated) token distribution. The blockchain platform offers a mobile-first mining approach, with low financial cost and a light environmental footprint within the crypto space. title: FactCheck: Was Satoshi Nakamoto an AI from the Future
body: The post FactCheck: Was Satoshi Nakamoto an AI from the Future appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ)’s tweet is going viral, claiming that Satoshi Nakamoto, the mysterious creator of Bitcoin, was actually an AI from the future. And, Pi Network’s AI-powered blockchain is proof that this theory could be real. But is there any truth to this claim? Here’s what Coinpedia’s finding says. Who Made This Claim? The theory gained attention after Binance founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) suggested “Satoshi was an AI from the future.” Supporters argue Bitcoin’s flawless code, perfect timing post-2008 crash, and Satoshi’s anonymous identity are signs of AI involvement. BINANCE FOUNDER CZ SAYS #BITCOIN FOUNDER “SATOSHI WAS AN AI FROM THE FUTURE.” pic.twitter.com/3Vue1fuXH6 — Vivek (@Vivek4real_) June 29, 2025 Pi Network’s advanced AI tools and ecosystem are presented as proof that blockchain is evolving with AI, continuing Satoshi’s vision. Coinpedia’s Analysis & Key Findings No Concrete Evidence: However, the tweet argues that Bitcoin’s bug-free core code, its game theory, and its release after the 2008 crash are signs of superhuman or AI-level planning. But, there is no verified proof that Satoshi was an AI or that AI wrote Bitcoin’s whitepaper . The claim remains speculative and unsupported by credible sources. Expert Views: Most blockchain experts credit Bitcoin’s creation to a highly skilled human or team, possibly with advanced knowledge of cryptography and economics, but not AI. Pi Network’s AI Use: While Pi Network integrates AI tools for development and smart staking, this is a recent development unrelated to Bitcoin’s origins. Summary Table: Coinpedia’s Evidence Against the Theory Claim Made by Theory Coinpedia’s Counter-Evidence Satoshi was an AI from the future No credible evidence; speculative theory. Pi Network’s AI proves this theory Pi’s AI is unrelated to Bitcoin’s creation. Satoshi’s anonymity indicates AI No factual basis; many humans remain anonymous. Conclusion Claim Satoshi Nakamoto was an AI from the future, and Pi Network’s AI features prove it. Verdict False Fact-Check by Coinpedia As per Coinpedia’s research and review of official sources, there is no credible evidence that Satoshi Nakamoto was an AI or that Pi Network’s AI features prove this theory. The claim remains science fiction, not fact. title: Younger Generations Will Drive Bitcoin Adoption, Says Analyst
body: Bitcoin may continue its upward trajectory in the long term as younger generations increasingly reject the existing financial system, according to market analyst Jordi Visser. Speaking on entrepreneur Anthony Pompliano’s podcast on Sunday, Visser explained that people under the age of 25 are disillusioned with rising economic inequality, AI-driven job losses, and the uncertainty surrounding traditional capitalist structures. “Younger people don’t have a belief that the system will come back,” Visser said, noting that the financial system appears to worsen every year in the eyes of younger demographics. As economic frustration grows, governments are likely to respond with increased public spending and money printing to sustain social benefits, a trend Visser believes will fuel Bitcoin’s rise as it increasingly replaces fiat assets. “The more people are angry, the more money the government has to print,” Visser added. “That’s why the price of Bitcoin will not stop going higher, regardless of what people say.” AI and Automation Threaten Traditional Capitalism Visser also highlighted the potential for advanced artificial intelligence and humanoid robotics to permanently disrupt capitalism by reducing the need for human labor while concentrating wealth within a small segment of society. This shift could force governments to reorganize economic structures and social safety nets to manage rising inequality and technological displacement. “I started heading down this journey in 2013 about exponential innovation and the dangers it would have on the fabric of capitalism,” Visser told Pompliano. According to the analyst, if wealth remains concentrated among a few while inequality continues to widen, societal instability will become inevitable. The rise of humanoid robots and self-driving cars will likely accelerate this trend. Visser believes these technologies will become a widespread commercial reality within the next five years, fundamentally altering industries and labor markets worldwide. Bitcoin Positioned for Long-Term Resilience The continued erosion of trust in traditional financial systems and the challenges posed by automation may push more people to view Bitcoin as a secure, alternative store of value . While Bitcoin’s price remains volatile in the short term, Visser’s analysis suggests that demographic shifts and technological changes could position Bitcoin for long-term growth as governments adapt to new economic realities. “When you start bringing Waymo and driving those cars into Manhattan, I think that’s a wake-up call,” Visser said, referencing past protests by Uber drivers to illustrate how technological disruption can reshape society and finance.c The post Younger Generations Will Drive Bitcoin Adoption, Says Analyst appeared first on TheCoinrise.com .

title: Israel’s $90M Nobitex Exploit Tied to Crypto-Funded Espionage
body: $90 million vanished from Iran’s Nobitex exchange, now, TRM Labs suggests pro-Israel hackers allegedly siphoned funds and possibly seized sensitive data to uncover Iranian spies paid in crypto Days after the hack, three Israeli citizens were arrested for allegedly carrying out espionage activities, such as performing surveillance, propaganda, and intelligence-gathering tasks in exchange for cryptocurrency payments on behalf of Iranian intelligence. Israeli Espionage Case Highlights Use of Crypto for State-Backed Operations In its report, TRM Labs noted “the arrests represent a rare public case of state-sponsored espionage in which operatives were compensated using digital assets.” The investigation alleges that each suspect received crypto payouts upon completing specific assignments, with funds delivered via anonymized blockchain channels. One of the accused, Dmitri Cohen, 28, from Haifa, reportedly tracked and photographed members of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s family. He is accused of spying on Amit Yardeni, Netanyahu’s future daughter-in-law, ahead of her wedding. Investigators say Cohen used a dedicated device to maintain encrypted contact with his Iranian handler and received thousands of dollars in crypto, about $500 per task. A second suspect, aged 27 from Tel Aviv, was detained for allegedly photographing military sites, government buildings, and tagging graffiti. Authorities seized several devices from his home during the investigation. Israel arrests 27-year-old Tel Aviv man for allegedly spying for Iran in exchange for crypto, spotlighting the growing role of digital assets in espionage. #Israel #Iran https://t.co/XC9ZKyJS9i — Cryptonews.com (@cryptonews) June 24, 2025 A third suspect, aged 19 from the Sharon region, reportedly passed classified information to Iranian contacts. He was allegedly recruited online and maintained prolonged communication with Iranian operatives during recent tensions between the two countries. While Israeli officials have not publicly connected the arrests to any specific cyber incident, TRM Labs suggests the timeline may point to a broader intelligence operation. TRM Labs Flags Possible Intelligence Overlap in Espionage Case Involving Nobitex Hack “Although Israeli authorities have not confirmed any connection between the hack and the arrests, the timing and tactical profile suggest potential intelligence overlaps,” TRM Labs noted. The firm noted that Israeli airstrikes occurred on June 13, followed by the hack of Iran-based crypto exchange Nobitex on June 18, and then the arrests on June 24. However, till now, there hasn’t been a solid evidence linking Israel to the June 18 cyberattack on Nobitex, Iran’s largest cryptocurrency exchange , although a pro-Israel hacking group Predatory Sparrow also know as “ Gonjeshke Darande” claimed responsibility for the breach. The fallout from the $100 million @nobitexmarket exchange hack continues to deepen as hackers release the platform’s full source code. #Hack #Nobitex https://t.co/1pAhbG3TAv — Cryptonews.com (@cryptonews) June 19, 2025 Additionally, the pro-Israel hacker group Gonjeshke Darande claimed to not only wipe $90 million of the exchange but also released the Iranian exchange’s full source code , including server lists, cold wallet scripts, and privacy settings. Notably, the group has previously targeted Iranian infrastructure for intelligence-gathering. TRM Labs suggests the breach could have granted access to KYC records, potentially aiding Israeli cyber units in identifying Iranian handlers or mapping crypto payments to local operatives. Iran’s use of cryptocurrency in covert operations is not new. Reports revealed that Iran routinely uses crypto to fund proxies, evade sanctions, and support cyber operations. In 2024, Russia and Iran increasingly turned to cryptocurrency to bypass Western sanctions, leveraging DeFi, no-KYC exchanges, and crypto for financial operations, according to @chainalysis #Russia #Iran #Sanctions https://t.co/ep1f3tLNms — Cryptonews.com (@cryptonews) February 17, 2025 Similar patterns have emerged in other countries. In the same year, South Korea arrested individuals linked to North Korean intelligence for passing military secrets in exchange for crypto. title: Bitcoin Policy: David Bailey Unveils Ambitious $100M Crypto PAC Initiative
body: BitcoinWorld Bitcoin Policy: David Bailey Unveils Ambitious $100M Crypto PAC Initiative Get ready for a seismic shift in the world of cryptocurrency advocacy! David Bailey, the influential CEO of BTC Inc., has dropped a bombshell announcement that could fundamentally reshape the future of Bitcoin policy in the United States. Imagine a dedicated political war chest, exceeding $100 million, singularly focused on advancing Bitcoin’s interests in Washington D.C. This isn’t just a hypothetical discussion; Bailey himself shared on X (formerly Twitter) his serious consideration of launching such a monumental Political Action Committee (PAC). What’s Happening? The Vision Behind the Bitcoin Policy PAC David Bailey’s vision is clear: to create a formidable lobbying force for Bitcoin, mirroring the impactful strategy of Fairshake, a prominent PAC already making waves in the broader crypto space. The proposed fund, with its staggering $100 million-plus target, would be an unprecedented commitment to shaping legislative outcomes specifically for Bitcoin. This isn’t about general blockchain advocacy; it’s about carving out a clear, favorable path for Bitcoin within the existing political framework. Bailey’s announcement underscores a growing realization within the industry: for Bitcoin to truly flourish and achieve its potential as a global, decentralized currency, it needs robust representation in the halls of power. The goal is to foster an environment where developers can innovate, businesses can grow, and individuals can securely utilize Bitcoin without undue regulatory burdens. This proactive stance aims to preempt unfavorable legislation and champion policies that recognize Bitcoin’s unique properties and its role in financial innovation. The sheer scale of this proposed fund signals a new era of political engagement from the Bitcoin community, moving beyond passive observation to active participation in shaping its destiny. Understanding the Power of a Crypto PAC So, what exactly is a Crypto PAC , and why is David Bailey’s potential venture such a significant development? A Political Action Committee (PAC) is a type of organization that pools campaign contributions from members and donates those funds to campaign for or against candidates, ballot initiatives, or legislation. In the context of cryptocurrency, a crypto PAC serves as a collective voice, amplifying the industry’s concerns and priorities to lawmakers. Here’s why PACs are so influential in the American political system: Resource Consolidation: They aggregate smaller contributions into a significant fund, giving them more leverage than individual donors. Targeted Support: PACs can strategically support candidates who are sympathetic to their cause or oppose those who are not, influencing election outcomes. Lobbying Power: Beyond direct contributions, PACs often fund lobbying efforts, educating politicians and their staff on complex issues and advocating for specific legislative changes. Visibility and Influence: A well-funded PAC gains significant attention from policymakers, ensuring the industry’s voice is heard during policy debates. For Bitcoin, a dedicated PAC means moving beyond fragmented advocacy to a unified, well-resourced effort. It signifies a maturation of the industry’s approach to political engagement, recognizing that technological innovation alone isn’t enough; political will and clear legal frameworks are equally vital. Learning from Fairshake: A Blueprint for Influence Bailey explicitly mentioned modeling his proposed Bitcoin PAC after Fairshake. Why Fairshake? This well-known PAC has rapidly emerged as a powerful force in the broader crypto ecosystem, demonstrating effective strategies for influencing policy. Fairshake’s mission is to support pro-crypto regulation, aiming to create a clearer legal framework for developers and foster the growth of the blockchain economy in the U.S. Key aspects of Fairshake’s success that Bailey likely seeks to emulate for Bitcoin include: Clear Mandate: Fairshake has a precise objective: to back candidates who champion responsible crypto innovation. A Bitcoin-specific PAC would narrow this focus even further, ensuring every dollar spent directly benefits Bitcoin’s unique needs. Significant Funding: Fairshake has raised substantial capital, allowing it to execute robust campaigns and support numerous candidates. Bailey’s $100M target indicates a similar ambition for the Bitcoin space. Strategic Engagement: Fairshake doesn’t just throw money at campaigns; it engages with lawmakers, provides educational resources, and helps shape the narrative around digital assets. This proactive educational component is crucial for complex topics like Bitcoin. Industry Alignment: Fairshake has garnered support from major players across the crypto industry, demonstrating a unified front. A Bitcoin PAC would aim to consolidate the vast and passionate Bitcoin community behind a common political agenda. By adopting the Fairshake model, David Bailey aims to leverage proven strategies for political effectiveness, but with a laser focus on the specific challenges and opportunities facing Bitcoin. This includes advocating for sound money principles, defending self-custody rights, and ensuring favorable tax treatment for Bitcoin holders and miners. David Bailey’s Strategic Move: A Game Changer for Bitcoin? The involvement of David Bailey , a prominent figure and CEO of BTC Inc. (the parent company of Bitcoin Magazine), lends significant weight to this initiative. His public statements carry influence within the Bitcoin community and beyond. His recent comment on X, suggesting that those who oppose the Bitcoin tax amendment could face political consequences in the upcoming midterm elections, highlights the urgency and potential aggressiveness of this new political push. This statement is a clear warning shot, indicating that the Bitcoin community is prepared to mobilize its resources to support candidates who align with its interests and oppose those who don’t. It transforms the conversation from mere advocacy to direct political accountability. For many in the Bitcoin space, clarity on tax treatment is paramount, as ambiguous or punitive regulations can stifle adoption and innovation. An amendment specifically addressing Bitcoin taxation could streamline compliance, reduce uncertainty, and potentially unlock greater institutional and retail participation. The potential for a well-funded PAC to influence midterm elections is substantial. By providing financial support, campaign infrastructure, and voter mobilization efforts, such a PAC could genuinely shift the balance in key races, electing more Bitcoin-friendly representatives. This move signals a coming-of-age for Bitcoin as a political force, ready to defend its principles on the legislative battlefield. Navigating the Regulatory Landscape: The Push for Clear Bitcoin Regulation The current regulatory environment for cryptocurrencies in the U.S. is often described as a patchwork of conflicting rules and interpretations. This ambiguity creates significant challenges for businesses, investors, and developers. A key objective of any Bitcoin-focused PAC would be to push for clear, concise, and favorable Bitcoin regulation . What kind of regulations are we talking about? Taxation: The aforementioned ‘Bitcoin tax amendment’ is a prime example. Clear rules on how Bitcoin is taxed (e.g., as property, currency, or a unique asset class) are crucial for mainstream adoption. Avoiding punitive taxes on small transactions or staking rewards would be a major win. Mining: Regulations around energy consumption, environmental impact, and zoning for Bitcoin mining operations are increasingly contentious. A PAC could advocate for policies that support domestic mining, recognizing its role in grid stability and energy innovation. Self-Custody: Protecting the right of individuals to hold their own Bitcoin keys without undue government oversight is a foundational principle for many in the community. Policies that infringe upon self-custody would be strongly opposed. Exchanges and Custodians: While not directly Bitcoin-specific, regulations affecting the on-ramps and off-ramps for Bitcoin (like exchanges) can significantly impact accessibility and liquidity. Advocating for sensible consumer protection without stifling innovation is key. Clarity on Securities vs. Commodities: For Bitcoin, which is largely considered a commodity, ensuring it remains outside the purview of securities laws (which are often ill-suited for decentralized digital assets) is vital. The establishment of a powerful PAC dedicated solely to Bitcoin means these specific issues can receive undivided attention and robust advocacy. It’s about ensuring that the unique characteristics of Bitcoin – its decentralization, fixed supply, and censorship resistance – are understood and respected by lawmakers, rather than being shoehorned into outdated regulatory frameworks. Why Now? The Urgency of Political Engagement for Bitcoin The timing of David Bailey’s potential initiative is no coincidence. The political landscape is heating up, with crucial midterm elections on the horizon. Many in the crypto space perceive a critical juncture where policy decisions made today could determine the trajectory of digital assets for years to come. Factors contributing to this urgency include: Increased Scrutiny: Lawmakers and regulators are paying more attention to crypto than ever before, often with a focus on perceived risks rather than benefits. Emerging Legislation: Numerous bills related to digital assets are circulating in Congress, some of which could be detrimental to Bitcoin’s growth if passed without proper input from the industry. Global Competition: Other nations are actively developing clear regulatory frameworks to attract crypto innovation, putting pressure on the U.S. to keep pace. Public Perception: Misinformation and negative narratives surrounding Bitcoin often influence public and political opinion. A well-funded PAC can help correct these narratives through education and advocacy. The proactive engagement via a significant PAC is a strategic move to ensure that the voice of Bitcoin is not only heard but is also a decisive factor in these critical policy debates. It’s about seizing the narrative and steering legislative efforts in a direction that supports, rather than hinders, Bitcoin’s evolution. Benefits of a Unified Bitcoin Voice The potential launch of a $100M Bitcoin PAC promises several profound benefits for the Bitcoin ecosystem: Educating Lawmakers: Many politicians lack a deep understanding of Bitcoin’s technology, economics, and societal benefits. A dedicated PAC can fund educational initiatives, bringing experts to Capitol Hill to provide clear, unbiased information. This helps demystify Bitcoin and fosters more informed decision-making. Countering Misinformation: The Bitcoin space is often plagued by FUD (Fear, Uncertainty, and Doubt) propagated by critics or those with vested interests in traditional finance. A powerful PAC can actively counter false narratives, presenting a factual and positive case for Bitcoin’s role in a modern economy. Protecting Innovation: Overly restrictive or poorly designed regulations can stifle technological innovation. By advocating for sensible, innovation-friendly policies, the PAC can help ensure the U.S. remains a leader in Bitcoin development and adoption. Empowering the Community: For individual Bitcoin holders and enthusiasts, a PAC provides a direct, impactful way to contribute to the political process. It transforms individual voices into a collective roar, demonstrating the significant political power of the Bitcoin community. Promoting Financial Freedom: At its core, Bitcoin represents financial sovereignty. A PAC focused on Bitcoin policy can champion legislation that protects individual rights to self-custody, transact privately, and participate in a permissionless financial system. These benefits collectively aim to solidify Bitcoin’s position not just as a technological marvel, but as a legitimate and respected asset class and a foundational element of future financial systems. Potential Challenges and Hurdles While the prospect of a $100M Bitcoin PAC is exciting, it’s important to acknowledge the potential challenges it might face: Political Resistance: The traditional financial lobby is powerful and well-entrenched. A new, well-funded Bitcoin PAC will undoubtedly face strong opposition from vested interests who see Bitcoin as a threat to their established order. Defining “Bitcoin-Related Issues”: While the core focus is Bitcoin, the exact scope of ‘Bitcoin-related issues’ might be debated. Will it extend to lightning network development, specific mining regulations, or broader economic policies that indirectly affect Bitcoin? Clear definitions will be crucial. Maintaining Public Trust: PACs, by their nature, can sometimes be viewed with skepticism. The Bitcoin PAC will need to operate with utmost transparency and integrity to maintain the trust of the community it represents and the public at large. Sustaining Funding and Momentum: While $100 million is a massive starting point, political campaigns and lobbying efforts are expensive and ongoing. Sustaining such a fund and maintaining momentum over multiple election cycles will require continuous effort and community support. Internal Disagreements: Even within the Bitcoin community, there can be diverse opinions on specific policy approaches. The PAC will need strong leadership to navigate these internal debates and present a unified front. Overcoming these challenges will be critical for the PAC to achieve its long-term objectives and effectively shape the regulatory landscape for Bitcoin. What This Means for You: Actionable Insights for the Bitcoin Community David Bailey’s potential $100M PAC is not just a high-level political maneuver; it has direct implications for every Bitcoin holder and enthusiast. It signals a shift from passive observation to active participation in shaping Bitcoin’s future. Here’s what this development means for you and how you might engage: Increased Awareness: Expect more media coverage and political debate around Bitcoin, bringing its benefits and challenges to a broader audience. Advocacy Opportunities: While the PAC will handle high-level lobbying, grassroots advocacy remains crucial. Stay informed about legislative developments and consider contacting your representatives on key issues. Understanding Your Candidates: In upcoming elections, pay closer attention to candidates’ stances on cryptocurrency and Bitcoin specifically. Your vote can contribute to electing pro-Bitcoin policymakers. Supporting the Ecosystem: Whether through direct contributions to the PAC (if launched), supporting Bitcoin-focused businesses, or simply educating friends and family, every action contributes to strengthening Bitcoin’s position. This initiative underscores that the future of Bitcoin isn’t solely determined by technological advancements, but also by the legislative and regulatory environments in which it operates. Active engagement, whether directly or indirectly, is now more important than ever. Conclusion David Bailey’s contemplation of a $100 million-plus Bitcoin policy PAC marks a pivotal moment for the cryptocurrency. By emulating the successful model of Fairshake and focusing specifically on Bitcoin-related issues, this ambitious initiative aims to provide an unparalleled level of advocacy and influence in Washington D.C. From navigating complex tax amendments to fostering a clear regulatory framework, the proposed PAC signifies a powerful, unified push to secure Bitcoin’s future in the United States. As the crypto landscape continues to evolve, such proactive political engagement will be instrumental in ensuring that innovation thrives and that the principles of financial freedom underpinning Bitcoin are protected for generations to come. The message is clear: the Bitcoin community is ready to fight for its future, not just in the digital realm, but in the political arena as well. title: Bitcoin Freezes Over $100,000 As OG Whales ‘Dump On Wall Street’: Expert
body: While Bitcoin continues to hover above the $100,000 threshold, the driving forces behind this historic consolidation phase appear to be more complex than the surface-level narratives of institutional “FOMO” and ETF euphoria. According to multiple leading analysts, a silent rotation is underway—one that suggests long-term holders are offloading their positions while corporate treasuries and institutional buyers quietly absorb the flood. OG Bitcoin Whales Are ‘Dumping’ On Wall Street Charles Edwards, founder of Capriole Investments, delivered a sobering breakdown via X on June 29, challenging the prevailing belief that Bitcoin’s price stagnation amid surging demand is anomalous. “People are wondering why BTC has been stuck at $100K so long, despite the institutional FOMO,” he wrote. “Despite what X news might suggest, it’s because Bitcoin OGs (long-term holders) have been dumping on Wall St since the ETF Launch in January 2024, unloading their positions.” Edwards, known for blending on-chain metrics with macro frameworks, pointed to a visible dynamic shift that is now being captured in blockchain data. While older coins are being redistributed, a newer class of holders—primarily treasury-oriented entities—are stepping in aggressively. “We have clearly entered the heat of [the Treasury Company] trend today as many copy-cats have entered the market,” he said, referencing his earlier prediction on Bits and Bips that corporate adoption would eventually eclipse ETF inflows in relevance. What makes this transition particularly remarkable is the data behind it. Edwards highlighted that 6-month-plus BTC holders—commonly associated with more strategic, non-speculative accumulation—have skyrocketed in the past two months. “The amount of BTC acquired in the last 2 months by this cohort has completely consumed all of the BTC unloaded by LTHs over the last 1.5 years,” he said. “Incredible.” Related Reading: Bitcoin In Stalemate With Liquidation Traps On Both Sides Of The Market This cohort’s aggressive accumulation, he added, has historically preceded bullish squeezes. “Whenever aggressive spikes in 6M+ holders occur, price usually squeezes following these periods. Short-term bullish,” Edwards remarked. However, he tempered the optimism by cautioning that broader on-chain data still signals fragility. “If the 6M+ holders (Treasury Companies) can continue their relentless buying, that should be achievable,” he noted, signaling that the flywheel has momentum, but is not yet immune to systemic pressure. Adding another layer to this developing narrative, Mauricio Di Bartolomeo, Co-founder and CSO at Ledn, offered an alternative theory. He suggested that what appears as two flows—LTHs selling and Treasury entities buying—might in fact be “the same trade.” He wrote, “Long term holders [are] selling spot to buy ETFs/BTC Treasury Cos. Even though that feels unnatural for us bitcoiners.” Di Bartolomeo framed the shift as generational, pointing out that many early adopters may simply be more comfortable in traditional financial custody rather than self-sovereign wallets. Related Reading: Analyst Spots Bitcoin Time Bomb Hidden In Bullish Weekly Chart But Edwards pushed back on that explanation, arguing that if ETF migration was driving the reclassification of long-term holders, it would be evident across multiple aging cohorts. “I don’t think so because we would have seen a similar uptrend over time in the 6M+ and 1Yr+ cohorts if that was the case,” he replied. “Some is definitely moving to equities, but it’s very typical of this stage of the Halving cycle to see LTH selling into profit.” Why Bitcoin ETF Do Not Have A 1:1 Effect On Price The apparent dissonance between rising demand and stagnant price has also prompted commentary from on-chain analyst TXMC, who warned that most observers misunderstand what actually sets Bitcoin’s price. “Bitcoin people grossly underestimate how little of the supply is actually setting the price every hour,” he wrote. He described Bitcoin’s fragmented market structure as a web of siloed exchanges, loosely synchronized through cross-exchange market-making. “Each location has its own liquidity and depth which vary wildly. A large market order can have an outsized effect depending on which exchange it is placed at, and which time of day.” TXMC argued that while ETFs and institutional desks are accumulating large quantities of Bitcoin, much of this activity is routed through OTC desks that bypass order books entirely. “These actions do not affect the price in the same way,” he said. “The desks source their own liquidity, and only have to go into the books to fill the difference.” This explanation may help reconcile why ETF inflows in the billions of dollars have failed to push BTC significantly higher. Edwards’ thesis aligns with this too, insofar as the ETF boom may be fueling redistribution rather than outright net demand. TXMC added: “Stop underestimating how many big entities are out there looking for exit liquidity.” Despite growing bullishness in cohort composition, the real test lies ahead. Whether corporate treasuries and ETF managers can absorb the remaining exit waves of Bitcoin’s earliest holders remains to be seen. But if Edwards is right, the rotation may already be past its critical phase. “The flywheel still has a long way to go,” Edwards concluded. And if history is any guide, these moments of consolidation amid redistribution tend to precede volatility—not follow it. At press time, BTC traded at $108,044. title: GoMining appoints R136 Ventures’ Victor Orlovski to advisory board
body: GoMining , a Bitcoin ( BTC ) mining platform, has announced that Victor Orlovski, founder and managing partner of R136 Ventures, is joining its Advisory Board, as per the reports shared with Finbold on Monday, June 30. With $420 million under his management and a portfolio featuring 30+ high-growth tech firms , Orlovski is known for aiding multiple companies to initial public offerings ( IPOs ) and Fortune 500 exits. He’s also the author of the Wall Street Journal bestseller From Rhino to Unicorn (2022), a book on how legacy institutions can evolve in the digital age. His advisory role at GoMining, therefore, reflects a broader trend of crypto-mining professionalization. GoMining Advisory Board At GoMining, Orlovski is joining a team that includes Tal Cohen, former Kraken US CEO and McKinsey strategist, Gleb Kostarev, who led Binance’s Asia-CIS expansion, and Igor Milihram, a founding force behind Magic Eden’s non-fungible token ( NFT ) marketplace. Together, the Advisory Board will work on improving regulated finance, Web3 infrastructure, and global growth execution. As part of their mission, the team will also identify regulatory blind spots, test new strategies against market realities, and help guide GoMining as it evolves into a trusted institutional partner. Additional advisory roles spanning hardware, decentralized finance ( DeFi ), and core infrastructure are currently in the pipeline. Changes in the crypto industry Orlovski’s arrival comes at a time of some drastic changes in the market. According to some projections, for example, more than 950 million people will adopt some form of crypto by the end of 2025. In addition, more than 130 public companies now hold over $87 billion in BTC, meaning institutional demand for scalable, yield-generating infrastructure is growing. In addition to Orlovski’s appointment, GoMining has recently reached another milestone, namely the listing of its native GOMINING token on KuCoin , expanding liquidity and institutional reach. GoMining growth GoMining currently supports 3.5 million users with its NFT model, where each digital miner represents real terahash capacity in the company’s data centers. In addition, GoMining operates a trading marketplace, the GameFi-powered mining game called Miner Wars , and an institutional arm called GoMining Institutional, alongside the $100 million Alpha Blocks Fund custodied by BitGo. The Alpha Blocks Fund is especially notable, offering structured exposure to mining-backed cash flows. This is a key innovation as traditional finance (TradFi) now seeks to explore productive crypto utilities and move past exclusively passive BTC holdings. title: Pundit to XRP Holders: The World Will See the Greatest Green Candle in History
body: Edoardo Farina, CEO of Alpha Lions Academy, shared a strong statement regarding the future of XRP in a recent tweet. title: 2.5M Crypto Tokens Launched in June, But…
body: The post 2.5M Crypto Tokens Launched in June, But… appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News This month alone, over 2.5 million new tokens have been created across major blockchains , including Ethereum, Solana, and Base, according to new data. But despite the volume, only a few networks show signs of sustainable value. A crypto expert recently broke down which chains offer the highest capital per token, revealing surprising insights about which ecosystems are thriving—and which are overloaded. Token Creation Trends: Ethereum Steady, Solana Slows, Base Surges According to reports and on-chain analysis, massive token creation is spreading across popular chains. The key observations: Solana is witnessing a slowdown in new token launches. Base is experiencing a sharp rise, driven by new platforms. Ethereum remains dominant in value despite fewer new tokens. Monthly number of unique crypto tokens created among the popular chains continues to maintain at ~2.5m in June. > @solana slowed down as @pumpdotfun slowly dies. > @base soared likely due to @virtuals_io . > @SonicLabs & @avax are starting to make a presence. A short : pic.twitter.com/v9JHU2Lk1N — (@bandaoppa) June 29, 2025 In a post on X, the expert highlighted that Pump.fun is responsible for most of Solana’s earlier surge but is now seeing reduced activity. On the other hand, Virtuals.io is driving Base’s uptick, marking a rise in AI-based Web3 projects. Why Are Pump.fun and Virtuals.io Important? Pump.fun : A Solana-based platform known for enabling quick and easy token launches, often used for memecoins . Its decline signals a drop in speculative token creation. Virtuals.io : A protocol merging AI and blockchain, currently booming on the Base network. This indicates rising interest in integrating AI agents into decentralized ecosystems. Additionally, SonicLabs and Avalanche are emerging as growing hubs for token creation, thanks to their performance, developer tools, and incentives. TVL Per Token: The Key Metric to Watch The expert introduced a simple but insightful analysis: Total Value Locked (TVL) divided by the number of tokens gives a snapshot of how much capital backs each token. Top blockchains by TVL per token: Ethereum : $53,700 per token TronDAO : $24,000 per token SonicLabs : $15,000 per token This suggests that Ethereum , despite not having the highest number of new tokens, maintains significantly higher capital per token. [post_titles_links postid=”476744″] Ethereum’s Strength Lies in Lido Finance The expert attributes Ethereum’s high capital efficiency to Lido Finance , a dominant liquid staking protocol. Users lock ETH and receive stETH, retaining liquidity while earning staking rewards. This structure locks in massive value across Ethereum’s ecosystem , making its token economy far more robust than chains that focus on sheer quantity of new launches. Solana and Base: Quantity Over Quality? The data reveals that Solana and Base have lower TVL per token, indicating oversaturation. While they may lead in token creation volume, the financial support per token is weaker. This trend suggests that only a very small percentage of tokens on these chains will hold any lasting value or achieve price growth. [article_inside_subscriber_shortcode title=”Never Miss a Beat in the Crypto World!” description=”Stay ahead with breaking news, expert analysis, and real-time updates on the latest trends in Bitcoin, altcoins, DeFi, NFTs, and more.” category_name=”News” category_id=”6″] FAQs Why are so many new tokens being created, especially on chains like Base, and what is driving this surge? Millions of new tokens are being created due to low barriers to entry and the ease of launching on platforms like Pump.fun (Solana) and Virtuals.io (Base). The surge on Base, in particular, is driven by new platforms and increasing interest in integrating AI agents into Web3 projects. How many of these newly created tokens actually gain lasting value or traction, and what factors determine their success? Only a very small percentage of newly created tokens gain lasting value. Success is determined by factors like strong utility, clear use cases, robust tokenomics, engaged community, transparent team, and sustained development, not just initial hype or volume of creation. In 2025 alone, over 1.82 million tokens have already stopped trading, indicating high failure rates. Will the trend of mass token creation lead to more innovation or more scams and low-value projects? The trend of mass token creation presents a dual edge: it can foster innovation by lowering entry barriers for legitimate projects, but it also creates fertile ground for scams, “rug pulls,” and the proliferation of low-value, speculative projects. The sheer volume makes it harder for valuable projects to stand out amidst the noise.

title: Altcoin Season Awaits: Decoding Crypto Market Cycles Amidst Bitcoin Dominance
body: BitcoinWorld Altcoin Season Awaits: Decoding Crypto Market Cycles Amidst Bitcoin Dominance Are you feeling the chill of a ‘crypto winter’ for altcoins, or is it just a temporary shift in the wind? The latest reading from the Altcoin Season Index, a crucial metric tracked by CoinMarketCap (CMC), provides a clear answer: at 22 on June 30, 00:35 UTC, the market is firmly in what’s known as Bitcoin Season . But what does this mean for your portfolio, and when can we expect the tides to turn for Altcoin Season ? Understanding the Altcoin Season Index: Your Compass for Crypto Market Cycles The Altcoin Season Index isn’t just a random number; it’s a sophisticated tool designed to give investors a snapshot of the broader cryptocurrency landscape. Developed by CoinMarketCap, this index helps us understand whether Bitcoin or the broader altcoin market is currently leading the charge. Here’s a closer look at how it works and why its current reading of 22 is significant: What it Tracks: The index meticulously compares the performance of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market capitalization (excluding stablecoins and wrapped tokens) against Bitcoin over the past 90 days. This 90-day window provides a robust, short-to-medium term perspective on market leadership. The Scorecard: Ranging from 1 to 100, the index paints a clear picture. A score above 75 indicates Altcoin Season, meaning 75% or more of the top 100 altcoins have outperformed Bitcoin. Conversely, a score of 25 or below signals Bitcoin Season, where 25% or fewer altcoins have managed to outshine Bitcoin. Current State: With the index at 22, it’s a strong confirmation that Bitcoin has been the dominant performer over the last three months. This period has seen capital flow predominantly into Bitcoin, often at the expense of altcoins, which tend to be more volatile and higher risk. For investors navigating the often-turbulent waters of the crypto space, understanding this index is akin to having a compass. It doesn’t predict the future, but it accurately reflects the present state of market dominance , guiding your strategic decisions. Decoding Bitcoin Season: Why Bitcoin Dominates the Cryptocurrency Market When the Altcoin Season Index dips below 25, we officially enter Bitcoin Season . This period is characterized by Bitcoin’s strong performance relative to most altcoins. But what drives this phenomenon, and why does the king of crypto often reclaim its throne? Several factors contribute to Bitcoin’s dominance during these periods: Safe Haven Appeal In times of market uncertainty, whether due to macroeconomic instability, regulatory concerns, or general risk aversion within the crypto space, investors often flock to Bitcoin. It’s perceived as the most established, liquid, and secure cryptocurrency, acting as a ‘digital gold’ or a safe haven asset. This flight to quality strengthens Bitcoin’s price while altcoins, being inherently riskier, see outflows. Institutional Interest Institutional adoption and investment often begin with Bitcoin. Large financial players, hedge funds, and corporations typically gain exposure to crypto through Bitcoin ETFs, futures, or direct purchases before venturing into the more speculative altcoin market. Increased institutional capital inflows disproportionately boost Bitcoin’s price and market capitalization. Halving Cycles Bitcoin’s programmatic supply shock, known as the halving, occurs approximately every four years. Historically, these events precede significant bull runs for Bitcoin. The reduced supply of new Bitcoin often leads to price appreciation, which can pull the entire market up, but Bitcoin usually leads the initial charge, drawing capital away from altcoins. Liquidity and Network Effect Bitcoin boasts the highest liquidity and the strongest network effect in the crypto space. This makes it easier to buy and sell large quantities without significant price impact, attracting more capital. Its widespread acceptance and robust infrastructure further solidify its position as the primary entry point for new capital into the crypto market. During Bitcoin Season, it’s common to see Bitcoin’s market dominance percentage (its share of the total crypto market cap) rise. This doesn’t mean altcoins can’t perform, but their gains are often less significant or more isolated compared to Bitcoin’s broad-based strength. The Allure of Altcoin Season: When the Tide Turns for Cryptocurrency Investing While we’re currently in Bitcoin Season, the crypto market is cyclical, and the allure of Altcoin Season is always present. This highly anticipated phase is when a vast majority of altcoins not only perform well but significantly outperform Bitcoin. It’s often where the most substantial percentage gains are made for those engaged in strategic cryptocurrency investing . What triggers the shift from Bitcoin dominance to an altcoin surge? Risk Appetite Returns After a period of Bitcoin-led growth, investors often gain confidence in the broader market. As Bitcoin’s price stabilizes or sees some profit-taking, capital tends to cascade down into altcoins. This happens as investors seek higher returns, willing to take on more risk for potentially larger gains. Technological Innovation and Narratives Altcoin Season is frequently fueled by new technological breakthroughs, burgeoning ecosystems (like DeFi, NFTs, Layer-2 solutions, AI, GameFi), or compelling narratives. Projects that offer novel solutions, scalability, or real-world utility can attract significant investment and user adoption, leading to exponential price growth. Lower Market Cap Potential Smaller market cap altcoins have a much higher potential for percentage growth compared to Bitcoin. A relatively small influx of capital can significantly move their prices, leading to rapid appreciation. This ‘penny stock’ appeal attracts speculative capital looking for 10x, 100x, or even 1000x returns. Ecosystem Development As various blockchain ecosystems mature (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, Polkadot), their native tokens and associated DeFi protocols, dApps, and NFTs gain traction. This organic growth within specific ecosystems can lead to concentrated rallies for their respective altcoins. Altcoin Season is characterized by widespread green charts across the board, with many projects seeing double-digit or even triple-digit gains in short periods. It’s a time of excitement and opportunity, but also heightened risk due to increased volatility and the potential for rapid corrections. Navigating the Cycles: Investment Strategies for Every Season Understanding whether you’re in Bitcoin Season or Altcoin Season is crucial for optimizing your cryptocurrency investing strategy. Different market environments call for different approaches to maximize gains and minimize risks. Here are some actionable insights: Strategies for Bitcoin Season (Index When Bitcoin is leading, the focus should primarily be on accumulating Bitcoin or stable, large-cap altcoins with strong fundamentals. Accumulate Bitcoin: This is often the best time to dollar-cost average into Bitcoin. As the dominant asset, it tends to be the first to recover and often provides a solid foundation for your portfolio. Selective Altcoin Picks: Not all altcoins will perform poorly. Focus on large-cap altcoins with established ecosystems, strong development teams, clear use cases, and solid community support. These ‘blue-chip’ altcoins might follow Bitcoin’s lead or consolidate, offering good entry points. Focus on Utility and Fundamentals: Avoid highly speculative, low-cap altcoins. Instead, research projects that solve real-world problems, have tangible products, or are integral to a thriving blockchain ecosystem. Reduce Risk Exposure: Consider taking profits from highly volatile or speculative altcoins that might have seen a pump, and reallocate to Bitcoin or stablecoins. Strategies for Altcoin Season (Index > 75) When the index signals Altcoin Season, it’s time to consider diversifying and capitalizing on the broader market rally. Diversify Smartly: While diversification is key, avoid spreading yourself too thin. Focus on a select number of promising altcoins across different sectors (DeFi, NFTs, Layer 1s, Gaming, AI) that have strong narratives and potential. Identify Emerging Narratives: Stay abreast of new trends and technologies. Often, Altcoin Season is driven by specific narratives gaining traction. Being early to these can lead to significant gains. Profit-Taking Strategy: Develop a clear profit-taking strategy. Altcoin pumps can be parabolic and unsustainable. Set price targets or percentage gains at which you will sell a portion of your holdings to secure profits. Risk Management: Use stop-loss orders to protect against sudden downturns. The higher the potential gains, the higher the inherent risks. Never invest more than you can afford to lose. General Strategies for All Crypto Market Cycles Regardless of the season, some principles remain timeless for successful cryptocurrency investing : Do Your Own Research (DYOR): Never invest based on hype alone. Understand the technology, team, tokenomics, and competitive landscape of any project. Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA): Regularly investing a fixed amount of money over time, regardless of price, can smooth out volatility and reduce the impact of market timing. Long-Term Vision: While short-term cycles offer trading opportunities, a long-term perspective often yields the best results in the crypto market. Identify projects with strong long-term potential. Stay Informed: Keep an eye on the Altcoin Season Index, Bitcoin dominance, and broader economic indicators. Market sentiment can shift rapidly. Beyond the Index: Other Factors Shaping Crypto Market Trends While the Altcoin Season Index is a powerful indicator, it’s just one piece of the puzzle. The broader crypto market trends are influenced by a multitude of interconnected factors. Understanding these can provide a more holistic view and enhance your investment decisions. Factor Description Impact on Market Cycles Macroeconomic Conditions Inflation rates, interest rate decisions by central banks, global geopolitical events, and traditional market performance (e.g., stock market indices). High inflation and rising interest rates can lead to a ‘risk-off’ environment, favoring Bitcoin (as a perceived inflation hedge) or stablecoins over altcoins. Economic recessions can dampen overall crypto enthusiasm. Regulatory Landscape New laws, government crackdowns, or clear regulatory frameworks from major economies (e.g., US, EU, Asia). Positive regulatory clarity can attract institutional investment and foster innovation, potentially boosting both Bitcoin and altcoins. Negative news can cause widespread sell-offs. Technological Advancements Breakthroughs in blockchain scalability (Layer 2s), new consensus mechanisms, privacy solutions, or interoperability. Significant tech advancements can create new narratives and drive altcoin rallies, especially for projects leading these innovations. Adoption and Utility Real-world use cases for cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology, increased user adoption of dApps, DeFi protocols, or NFT platforms. Growing adoption signals fundamental value, supporting long-term growth for specific altcoins and contributing to overall market maturity. Social Sentiment & Hype Public perception, social media trends, influencer activity, and mainstream media coverage. Can create short-term pumps and dumps, particularly for smaller altcoins. Strong positive sentiment can accelerate market rallies, while fear and doubt can trigger corrections. Monitoring these external factors alongside the Altcoin Season Index gives you a comprehensive view, allowing for more informed and resilient cryptocurrency investing strategies. Challenges and Opportunities in Market Cycles Every market cycle presents both challenges and opportunities. Understanding these can help you navigate the ups and downs of the crypto market with greater resilience. Challenges: Volatility: Both Bitcoin and altcoins are highly volatile. Rapid price swings can lead to significant losses if not managed properly. Emotional Investing: The fear of missing out (FOMO) during bull runs and panic selling during downturns are common pitfalls. Scams and Rug Pulls: Particularly during Altcoin Season, the proliferation of new projects can include fraudulent schemes designed to trick investors. Information Overload: The sheer volume of news, social media discussions, and technical analysis can be overwhelming, making it hard to discern reliable information. Regulatory Uncertainty: Evolving regulations can create sudden shifts in market sentiment and impact the viability of certain projects. Opportunities: Compounding Gains: Successfully navigating cycles by buying low and selling high (or taking profits) can lead to substantial wealth accumulation over time. Innovation Investment: The crypto market is at the forefront of technological innovation. Investing in groundbreaking projects can offer immense long-term returns. Democratization of Finance: Crypto offers opportunities for financial participation previously unavailable to many, fostering new financial paradigms. Learning and Growth: Engaging with the crypto market forces you to learn about technology, economics, and human psychology, providing valuable life skills. Conclusion: Preparing for What’s Next in Crypto Market Cycles The Altcoin Season Index at 22 clearly indicates that we are in a period dominated by Bitcoin. This Bitcoin Season is a natural part of the broader crypto market cycles , offering unique challenges and opportunities for those engaged in cryptocurrency investing . While altcoins may be taking a backseat for now, history shows that market sentiment can shift rapidly, and the vibrant energy of Altcoin Season will inevitably return. Successful navigation of these cycles hinges on a few key principles: staying informed with metrics like the Altcoin Season Index, understanding the underlying drivers of both Bitcoin and altcoin performance, implementing robust risk management, and maintaining a disciplined investment strategy. Whether you’re accumulating Bitcoin, researching the next big altcoin, or simply observing the evolving landscape, remember that patience and knowledge are your most powerful assets. By preparing for what’s next, you position yourself to thrive regardless of which season the crypto market brings. title: Bitcoin Price Not Being Suppressed, Selling by Long-Term Holders, Checkmate Says
body: Bitcoin (BTC) has been consolidating above $100,000 since the start of May. The only time the price drop below $100,000 was on 22 June, which was a weekend when tensions escalated between Iran and the U.S. However, due to typically low trading volume over weekends, price action is often less reliable during those periods since crypto is the only industry that trades continuously. Despite ongoing discussions about public companies acquiring bitcoin globally, on top of the availability of exchange-traded funds in the United States, investors are still wondering why bitcoin has not yet broken to new all-time highs above $112,000. On-chain data, specifically the revived supply breakdown by age, shows elevated levels of bitcoin being sold by investors who have held their coins for a minimum of 3 years and in some cases for over 10 years. Analyst Checkmate provided this data and commented, “Look at all this price suppression selling by market manipulators who acquired their coins more than 3 years ago and are definitely not selling for profit in a bull market... Much paper.” This implies that for every buyer there is a seller, and in a bull market, the higher the price climbs, the more likely the market will find sellers willing to offload their holdings. Checkmate further added , “Always chopping sideways. Suppression == Boredom.” As bitcoin has been consolidating for some time, this is typically where the narrative of market suppression gains traction. However, the data indicates that persistent selling pressure continues rather than deliberate suppression.
